(ii)The supplier has to submit detailed specification/ brochure of the items along with pictures of the items i n the technical bid. 9. The items shall be delivered F.O.R, BDL,Kanchanbagh,Hyderabad (Free delivery to BDL stores). 10. Installation including accessories required are in the scope of vendor. Vendor shall demonstrate the sy stem in integrated condition with PC. Necessary hardware/Software required for the integration /demonstr ation are in the scope of vendor, and to be supplied along with the equipment.BDL will provide stand alone PC for interfacing. 11. Vendor has to submit the specification of Software/Hardware requirement of Desktop PC (mentioned in Sl.No. 10) in the technical bid. Commercial Terms: 1.Payment terms: 100% payment with 100 % taxes and duties will be made within 30 days after receipt a nd acceptance of material at BDL. 2. Liquidated damages: Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery sho uld be strictly insisted upon according to the delivery schedule given in the PO. In the event the supplier fa ils to deliver the goods / service, within the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover fro m the supplier, LD and not by way of penalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5 % of the price only of the stores (Including duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesai d for each week of delay or part thereof, subject to a maximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery per iod, increase in taxes shall not be borne by BDL, if delay is attributable to vendor. 3. BDL reserves the right to process and finalize the tender among the technically acceptable offers by con ducting on-line e-reverse auction ( after opening the price bids) and bringing all vendors to equal level play ing field in respect of techno-commercial conditions or may finalize the tender without e-reverse auction , i f required by BDL. The process adopted for e-reverse auction is at the discretion of BDL. The details of auct ioning will be given to the vendors in advance and familiarization will be arranged for the same, if required . 4. The Prices indicated in the PO (After finalizing the bids and release of PO) are firm and fixed i.e., no subj ect alteration / variation on any account unless specified in the purchase order. 5. Purchase Preference (PP) Clause (Make in India): order 2017 is applicable details can be submitted with the bids. 6. "HSN Code: Vendor has to provide HSN code (six digit code) for the items". 7. All other general terms and conditions as per BDL limited tender terms and conditions. 8. GST Clause: "BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law". .
